description: This is a shell script implementing a series of automated tests for Git pre-push hooks, including setup, testing successful pushes, failing hooks, bypassing hooks, deleting branches, pushing to URLs, and handling many refs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands and checking for success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after the test finishes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and asserts their equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up and executes Git hooks for testing.
